method_floor.convergence_rule: The current union formation is an additional refinement pass; it earns closure only through two fresh consecutive hostile clean passes over one unchanged corpus epoch.

shared_laws: Motion is state communication: light acknowledges before geometry, tracked input remains one-to-one, release inherits measured velocity, and exit is faster and asymmetric.
The app owns one quiet signature system; generic ambient animation is forbidden. Procedural substrates and the single active selection lens may breathe at idle with zero idle requestAnimationFrame.
Every role consumes an explicit dose. A dash in the suffusion matrix is a prohibition, not missing work.
Reduced motion removes physics but never state, focus, reachability or information.
Native focus, committed values and content state remain truth; lenses, fill overshoot and light are paint only.
Material, motion and geometry are measured on the rendered app before thresholds are fixed.
reconciliation.value_signature: Optical instrumentarium: semantic watercolor dots and value-bearing slider/readout surfaces respond through restrained light, shell-pop precision and continuous color-space meaning; the watercolor field is the memorable gesture, not a decorative animation layer.
reconciliation.keyframes_signature: Kinetic stage: one quaternion/pointer-energy contract carries through every scene, while scene-specific choreography, the collapsed glass dock and precise curve instruments make motion itself legible; the app is not a Value reskin.
reconciliation.idle_ruling: The user's Breath of Life direction is satisfied through meaningful procedural/substrate motion, focus/hover/engage response and one selection-lens license. It does not authorize universal idle shimmer, duplicated light systems, idle rAF or animation on data whose state did not change.
reconciliation.measurement_first: C00P supplies the safe-area, touch, motion, accessibility and rendered-geometry probes. No D/M/G motion wave may turn approximate corpus values into a product gate before its relevant C00P record exists.
